Name: Sepharad
ModernLocation: Unknown; candidates include Sardis, Saparda, Sparta, Media, and Spain
Description: Sepharad was a place of exile where captives of Jerusalem were settled, named in Obadiah's oracle as the home of a captivity that would possess the cities of the south.
BiblicalSignificance: Sepharad is an exile name: a distant settlement whose captives, Obadiah says, would return to possess the south.
